Airport runs are one-way transfers that cover any Sky Harbor to Scottsdale run with time for baggage: $225 in the Luxury SUV, $295 in the Executive Sprinter. A transfer is flat within 15 road miles from pickup to drop-off; longer transfers are priced from the drive with the empty return included.

Common Corporate Scenarios

Airport VIP Arrival

The setup: flight number shared at booking, chauffeur monitoring status, meet-and-greet at baggage claim with a name sign, luggage handled, cabin already cool.

What goes wrong without it: a fare you learn at the curb, no flight monitoring when the flight lands early, a vehicle too small for golf clubs, a driver who looks like a rideshare driver.

Cost: Luxury SUV, one-way transfer, $225, or $243 with tax.

Client Entertainment

The scenario: a major client in town. Dinner at Mastro's, a show at Talking Stick, drinks after.

The solution: Luxury SUV with a professional chauffeur, 5-hour block.

  • 6:30 PM pickup from the client's hotel
  • 7:00 PM Mastro's; the chauffeur handles valet
  • 9:30 PM to Talking Stick
  • 11:00 PM post-show, open to direction
  • 11:30 PM return to the hotel

Cost: $625, or $675 with tax. The client experiences a seamless evening, and you are the host who had everything handled.

Conference Transportation

The scenario: 200 attendees at the Fairmont Scottsdale Princess, airport arrivals spread across a day, an off-site dinner at Sassi.

The solution: a small fleet with one coordinator.

  • Arrivals: three Executive Sprinters running continuous PHX-to-Princess loops from 10 AM to 6 PM. Eight hours each bills 7, so $1,015 per vehicle and $3,045 for the three.
  • Off-site dinner: three Executive Mini Coaches departing the Princess at 6:00 PM, two loops each, returning at 10:00 PM. Five hours each is $1,125 per bus, $3,375 for the three.
  • Departures: scheduled by flight over two days.

Coordinator role: a single point of contact, real-time manifest updates, on-site at departure points, problems solved before you hear about them.

Executive Roadshow

The scenario: a CEO visiting four Valley locations in one day and needing a mobile office.

The solution: Executive Sprinter for the day.

  • 7:00 AM pickup from the Four Seasons
  • 8:00 AM Chandler office
  • 10:30 AM Tempe client
  • 12:30 PM lunch meeting at Desert Ridge
  • 3:00 PM Scottsdale HQ
  • 5:00 PM return to the hotel

Cost: 10 hours bills 9, $1,305 before 8% tax. Upgrade to the Maybach Jet Sprinter for $2,655.

Booking Corporate Transportation

What We Need from You

Basic reservations: date and time, pickup and drop-off, passenger count, flight info for airport service, a day-of contact.

VIP reservations: all of the above plus guest preferences, protocol requirements, and billing instructions.

Lead Time

Availability varies by date and by vehicle. Request a current quote for your date and we will confirm what is open. Send the schedule — dates, times, pickup points and the headcount for each run — and we will confirm which vehicles are open and quote them. Paid online checkout closes 24 hours before pickup; inside that window, call our reservations team.

Corporate FAQs

Do you provide W-9s and insurance certificates for vendor onboarding?
Yes. Ask our reservations team when you book.

Can we open a corporate account with consolidated billing?
Yes, for companies with regular transportation needs.

How do you handle last-minute changes?
Call the reservations team; we accommodate changes whenever the schedule allows. One free date change at any tier when requested 72 or more hours ahead.

What happens if a flight is delayed?
We monitor it and adjust automatically.

What is the cancellation policy?
Cancellation terms depend on your date and booking; read the cancellation policy before you book. Details on the policies page.

Do you know the local hotels and venues?
Yes. Our chauffeurs know the entrances and staging areas at the Fairmont Princess, Four Seasons, The Phoenician, and the other major Scottsdale venues.
